finalText:
It builds clean now. Two real bugs were hiding under all the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump.

1. `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.
2. `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. It now just checks for `true`, so unset means disabled.

Build finishes in 44.9s with 0 errors, retry budget resolves to 3, and backoff correctly shows as disabled.
